description.value: Commit permanently to one of the five Draws — Twin Iron, Long Iron, Close Iron, Trick Iron or Foul Iron. That Draw's restricted feats become legal picks for you at their stated levels. You never gain its Minor or Major Capstone: those are granted by the class itself at 10th and 20th, and a dip is not the class.

cinderfall.incomplete: Committing to a Draw only unlocks eligibility for later feat picks (Advanced Iron) -- it does not itself grant any of the Draw's classfeature benefits (the card is explicit that those stay the class's own). A ChoiceSet could record the choice as a flag, but no other card's ChoiceSet filter can read a sibling item's flags.system.rulesSelections at selection time (filters query compendium traits/tags on candidate items, not flags set by a different item on the same actor), so recording the choice would have zero mechanical effect on which feats Advanced Iron can later offer -- a rule element here would be semantically null.
